newsitem.title: USA: Sonat Cook-3 tests 35 mln cu ft/day.
newsitem.headline: Sonat Cook-3 tests 35 mln cu ft/day.

text.p: Sonat Inc said in a statement with earnings that it has tested its most recently completed Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef discovery, the Sonat Exploration Cook No. 3 in the Bear Grass area of Leon County, Texas.
Sonat holds a 50 percent interest in the block.
The well flowed at the rate of 35 million cubic feet of natural gas per day with flowing wellhead pressure of 6,750 psi on a 31/64-inch choke from a reef completion interval of 15,133 to 15,740 feet.

"This is the second largest initial flow rate from any of the company's Pinnacle Reef wells to date. The company believes the Cook No. 3 has 60 to 70 Bcf of recoverable natural gas reserves," the company said.
Sonat Exploration's reef acreage position is now up to 340,000 acres of leases for which it is also the operator.
